ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Our Pixs uses the camera to scan event QR codes and take photos for the shared album.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Our Pixs lets you choose photos and videos to add to an event album.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Our Pixs saves event photos and videos you download to your photo library.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Our Pixs uses the microphone to record sound with videos for the event album.
